objective: Harden the MCP gateway: correct HTTP session handling, tool list change notifications, upstream liveness for HTTP upstreams, deterministic routing, config validation, opt-in auth and repo cleanup.
problem: Audit on 2026-11-14 found: unknown session ids answered 400 instead of 404 and leaked transports (A1); sessions never cleaned (A2); no tools/list_changed (A3); HTTP upstreams never detected as down (A4); no auth on 0.0.0.0 with docker socket and engram mounted (A5); unhandled async handler errors (M1); no graceful shutdown (M2); non-deterministic tool name collisions (M3); 100kB body limit (M4); cancellation not propagated (M5); weak config validation (M6); listTools pagination ignored (M7); lefthook references a missing .gitleaks.toml (M8).

out: codebase-memory daemon failing to start in the container (A6)
uncommitted user changes in servers.json and servers.json.bak-atlas-rag

tasks.description: HTTP sessions. Extract the Express app to src/app.ts (createApp(gateway, opts)); src/server.ts keeps bootstrap only. 404 JSON-RPC for unknown mcp-session-id; new transport only on initialize; transport.onclose removes the session; DELETE delegates to transport.handleRequest; try/catch in handlers with 500 JSON-RPC; express.json limit 4mb. server.ts: validate PORT, exit(1) on fatal error, graceful SIGTERM/SIGINT. Tests in src/app.test.ts over real HTTP.

tasks.description: Upstream liveness and close. gateway.ts: periodic ping per connected upstream (pingIntervalMs, default 30s); on failure close the client so handleDisconnect reconnects.
